subject.title: Tailscale serve creates redundant entries on gateway startup

question: Should the canonical fix for this issue use scoped OpenClaw-owned Serve cleanup, broad `tailscale serve reset`, or pause until a proof-positive sibling PR establishes a safer path?
rationale: The bug is real from source inspection, but the obvious reset-before-serve fix can delete unrelated operator-managed Serve routes, so automation should not choose the permanent cleanup policy without maintainer intent.

options.title: Use Scoped Startup Cleanup
options.body: Prefer cleanup that targets OpenClaw's own Serve route or named service and preserves unrelated operator-managed Serve entries.

options.title: Accept Broad Reset
options.body: Allow `tailscale serve reset` on startup, but document the operator impact and require live before/after proof.

options.title: Wait For A Better Candidate
options.body: Keep this issue open until one linked PR supplies both safe cleanup behavior and live restart proof.

recommendation.title: Use Scoped Startup Cleanup
recommendation.body: Prefer cleanup that targets OpenClaw's own Serve route or named service and preserves unrelated operator-managed Serve entries.

likelyOwner.reason: The service-name work is the closest merged history for scoped Serve cleanup semantics in this path.
